subject: general
question: _________ protects circuits and appliances by stopping the flow of excessively high electric current.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fuse**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fuse **

 
 
• A fuse is a short piece of metal, inserted in the series with the circuit, which melts when excessive current flows through it and thus breaks the circuit.
 
• The function of a fuse is to carry the normal current without overheating but when the current exceeds its normal value.
 
• It rapidly heats up to the melting point and disconnects the circuit protected by it.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​**Electric heater**

 
 
• The Element of an electric heater is made up of Nichrome__.
 
• This is because Nichrome has very high melting point when compared to other elements.
 
• Hence Nichrome converts the Electrical energy into Heat energy.
